extra.message: User input from request.form['address'] is concatenated directly into a shell command string ('nslookup ' + address) and executed via popen (intended as rp function). This allows command injection through shell metacharacters like ;, |, &, $(), etc.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: XML parser is configured with no_network=False and dtd_validation=True, allowing external entity processing. User-controlled XML from request.form['xml'] is parsed without disabling external entities, enabling XXE attacks to read files, perform SSRF, or cause denial of service.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: User input from request.form['name'] is inserted into a template string using string formatting, then rendered via render_template_string(). This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Jinja2, enabling remote code execution through template expressions like {{config}} or {{''.__class__.__mro__[2].__subclasses__()}}.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
